messages:
nina_dev: quick follow-up from the recent postmortem on recurring eviction spikes. want to make sure remediation work becomes automated coverage and tracked to closure. I sketched a compact plan below: 1) CI regression that runs a tiny fault-injector, 2) nightly tenant-blast with cost cap, 3) incident-derived promptset + eval thresholds, 4) recurrence-detection alert and ownership rotation. who can own which?
sam_sre: I can take the CI fault-injector + recurrence-detection alert. plan: lightweight CI step (feature-flag flip for 20s) and a recurrence detector that looks for eviction spikes in the last 24h window. filing RINF-6005.
oliver_ml: I9ll own promptset and eval harness. goal: produce a small, targeted promptset that reproduces the eviction signal (long context churn + noisy short bursts). will wire it into nightly evals and include quality proxies. filing RINF-6006.
frank_ops: I9ll take the nightly tenant-blast job and cost-guard plumbing. will use k6 -> k8s, simulate 30 baseline tenants + 1 noisy tenant, ramp and sustain patterns. filing RINF-6007.
nina_dev: thanks. couple of process asks: a) tag all tickets with "postmortem-eval", b) add expected PR date to the ticket, c) add an owner rotation note for recurrence alerts so oncall knows who to ping next.
sam_sre: noted. recurrence alert spec: if eviction-rate spikes > 2x baseline twice in 72h, open a P0 candidate in incidents channel and assign to the on-call followed by the owner on the ticket. will add owner-rotation field to RINF-6005.
oliver_ml: promptset sketch (short descriptors) that I'll commit to RINF-6006 repo: 
```
P1: multi-turn 12k context with repeated backward refs to force KV churn
P2: burst of short 1-3 token queries from 100 concurrent clients hitting same convo id
P3: mixed tenant mix (49 normal + 1 noisy doing long updates)
METRICS: eviction-rate, p95-latency, quality-proxy (BLEU/rouge proxies)
FAIL GATES: eviction-rate delta > 10% OR p95 > +20% OR quality-proxy drop >5%
```
will include minimal repro snippets and an evaluation dashboard link.
frank_ops: nightly job plan: ramp 10->200 users over 10m, sustain for 90m, repeat x2. two modes: hosted-only & hosted+dedicated. cost cap set to $X/day (in ticket). run under test-org creds.
nina_dev: timeline asks: CI regression PR by 2025-03-03, promptset + eval in nightly by 2025-03-17, nightly tenant-blast integrated by 2025-03-24, recurrence alert + rotation by 2025-03-10. realistic?
sam_sre: CI + recurrence alert by 2025-03-03 ok.
oliver_ml: 2 sprints for promptset + harness, target 2025-03-17 OK.
frank_ops: nightly job needs infra creds but target 2025-03-24 doable if creds unblocked. adding escalation to eng-sre and finance in the ticket.
oncall-bot: Calendar invite created: "Eviction coverage handoff" Mon 09:30 PT  link: https://calendar.redwood/eviction-coverage
nina_dev: final ask  please update the postmortem board with these tickets and add a short owner timeline card. I'll follow up in 1 week for status. thanks all :thumbsup:
